title: Unified telemetry ingestion with version-aware adapters for SDK / CLI / API
creator: Elena Kim
description: Goal: standardize how telemetry events from SDK, CLI, and public API carry schema version metadata and route through a gateway that performs minimal adapter transformations. Current state: three parallel ad-hoc encodings (SDK header X-RW-TEL-V, CLI JSON envelope v1, API path-encoded version) cause multiple decoders in our ingestion pipeline and frequent consumer breakages when we evolve analytics schemas. This ticket defines a version-aware adapter strategy, gateway routing rules, and a migration plan to move producers to a single canonical header + fallback envelope pattern, with backward compatibility for at least two prior versions.
acceptance_criteria: Gateway accepts telemetry from SDK/CLI/API and normalizes version metadata into X-RW-TEL-V or envelope.version field
Ingestion pipeline consumers (events-parser, usage-aggregator) can decode v1..v3 using shared decoder library
Adapter transformations limited to non-destructive mapping; no business logic changes in gateway
Compatibility test harness added to CI with synthetic events for each supported version
Rollout plan documented and smoke-tested in staging with canary at 5% and automated rollback on decoder errors
checklist: Design: adapter interface and header/envelope spec
Implement: gateway header normalizer and lightweight CLI adapter
Library: shared telemetry-decoder supporting v1..v3 and feature-flagged v4
Tests: unit + integration + CI compatibility matrix
Observability: add telemetry-schema dashboard and alerts for decode error rate > 0.5%
Rollout: staging canary -> production 5/25/50/100 with rollback playbook

notes: Migration approach: encourage producers to set X-RW-TEL-V header; gateway will read header if present, else inspect envelope.version, else fall back to vendor-specific heuristics.
Decoder library will maintain a small transform map to rename/normalize fields: e.g., clientId -> client_id, actionType -> user_action. Mapping rules must be idempotent and reversible where possible.
Performance constraint: gateway normalization must add <2ms p50 latency and be CPU-light; heavier normalizations deferred to the ingestion pipeline batch stage.
Monitoring: add metrics for (a) percent of events with header present, (b) decode_error_rate per producer, (c) avg normalization latency in gateway. Alert on sudden drop in header adoption rate.

Rollout safety: will run ingestion consumers in compatibility-mode where new decoder emits both normalized and raw-parsed fields to allow downstream verification before cutover. After 2 weeks with no regressions, switch producers read-path to normalized fields only.

Fallback policy: if a new unrecognized version is seen, gateway will tag event with telemetry_version=unknown and route to a quarantine topic for manual triage while forwarding a reduced envelope to primary pipeline to avoid data loss.
Follow-ups: automated SDK/CLI quickstart snippets, updated docs in /docs/telemetry, and a migration tracker for external partners
